# Generic array tails with ordinary object results

An independently owned static provider accepts closed reference/scalar contexts
and a method-owned array through a varargs declaration. Frozen direct, separately
compiled caller, reflection and fixed-arity MethodHandle paths retain the explicit
array, its runtime component, mutations, null/empty forms, original checked and
unchecked failures, context identities and opaque result. Both profiles compile
every emitted source and compare definitions, roles, Signature and Exceptions.
Fourteen wrong implementations qualify 104 fresh cases, each repeated twice;
eight same-Code Signature controls qualify the rejection boundary.
